subject.title: [Feature]: Add JSON-RPC bindings for language-agnostic plugins

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-class manifest/SDK JSON-RPC child-process plugin ABI, and is https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98005 the API shape maintainers want to support?
rationale: The request creates a new public plugin API and security-sensitive process boundary, and the current item is maintainer-authored, protected, and paired with an open draft implementation candidate.

options.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the linked PR's manifest ABI, protocol, capability permissions, lifecycle, docs, and support contract.

options.title: Narrow the ABI first
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a smaller protocol or experimental/internal gate before accepting a broad language-neutral plugin contract.

options.title: Decline core support for now
options.body: Close only after maintainers decide language-neutral plugin runtimes should remain one-off plugin-owned bridges instead of a core SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the linked PR's manifest ABI, protocol, capability permissions, lifecycle, docs, and support contract.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa opened the maintainer-owned issue and owns the linked implementation candidate, making them the most direct API-direction owner from the available evidence.
